title: As Meta shifts resources away from its Supernatural VR fitness service, users mourn the loss of a community built around the platform and its coaches (Boone Ashworth/Wired)
summary: Boone Ashworth / Wired: As Meta shifts resources away from its Supernatural VR fitness service, users mourn the loss of a community built around the platform and its coaches — Users of the VR fitness service are distraught that Supernatural has had its staff cut and won't receive any more content updates.
